title: Make a payment endpoint idempotent
brief: Your service has `POST /payments`. Mobile clients on poor networks retry when a request times out, and some customers have been charged twice. Design the change that makes the endpoint safe to retry.
deliverables: How the client names an operation (the header, who generates the key, how long it stays valid)
The table or record that stores keys and results, with its constraints
What the server does when the same key arrives twice in sequence, and twice at the same moment
What it does when the key is reused with a different body
The tests you would write to prove it
